3041: function tenureInfo(hireDate,refDate){
3042:  if(!hireDate)return {months:0,years:0,remMonths:0,label:"Não informado"};
3043:  let a=new Date(hireDate+"T12:00:00"),b=refDate?new Date(refDate+"T12:00:00"):new Date();
3044:  if(b<a)return {months:0,years:0,remMonths:0,label:"0 meses"};
3045:  let months=(b.getFullYear()-a.getFullYear())*12+(b.getMonth()-a.getMonth());
3046:  if(b.getDate()<a.getDate())months--;
3047:  months=Math.max(0,months);
3048:  let years=Math.floor(months/12),rem=months%12;
3049:  return {months,years,remMonths:rem,label:years?`${years} ano${years!==1?"s":""} e ${rem} mês${rem!==1?"es":""}`:`${months} mês${months!==1?"es":""}`};
3050: }
3051: function calcINSS2026(base){
3052:  base=Math.max(0,+base||0);
3053:  const bands=[
3054:    {limit:1621.00,rate:.075},
3055:    {limit:2902.84,rate:.09},
3056:    {limit:4354.27,rate:.12},
3057:    {limit:8475.55,rate:.14}
3058:  ];
3059:  let prev=0,total=0;
3060:  for(const b of bands){
3061:    let taxable=Math.max(0,Math.min(base,b.limit)-prev);
3062:    if(taxable>0)total+=taxable*b.rate;
3063:    prev=b.limit;
3064:    if(base<=b.limit)break;
3065:  }
3066:  return Number(total.toFixed(2));
3067: }
